{{Quote|What are your plans on Alderaan?''"<br />"''I want to go down to your continent of Thon and take part in the hunting.|[[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] and [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Tion (Lord)/Legends|Tion]]|<ref name="Star Wars (radio)">[[Star Wars (radio)|''Star Wars'' radio drama]]</ref>}}
'''Thon''' was one of the continents of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. Thon was notable for [[The Uplands]], a peaceful, pastoral region.
